Scope: `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/**` (95 files, 27,284 LOC, 42% comment density). ~970 lines leave — the largest shard.

Dominant category: 28 sites carrying 'RELOCATED VERBATIM ... forced by the LOCKED 800-line cap' (~75 lines), already single-sourced in `.github/module-size-limit.txt`, AGENTS.md and ADR 0058.

Four new ADRs proposed, each consolidating an argument restated 4-8 times: field-convergence fit-then-normalize (8 sites); pagination-stall aborts past fail-open handlers (3 independent arguments, 3 prior incidents); unmapped relations skipped not approximated; core owns the value maps. Plus amendments to ADR 0028, 0055 §(g), 0031, 0035.

Verified stale: `_backend_registry.py:3` 'STUB: signatures pinned, bodies to be implemented' while `select_backend` is imported by 13 modules; the S3/S4-not-landed notes in `_backend.py` and `adapters/jira/backend.py`.

Headroom: `_ref_lock.py` 1 -> ~21, `dispatch_one.py` 14 -> ~57, `inbound_differ.py` 18 -> ~66, `binding_store.py` 18 -> ~33, `fetcher.py` 29 -> ~80.

This subtree's comments are overwhelmingly measured external-API facts that cannot be re-derived from code. The do_not_move list is the most valuable output of the shard.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every non-KEEP unit in scope is relocated or deleted per its destination
- [ ] The shard's do_not_move list is appended to `.joe-janitor/tools.md` BEFORE any edit lands
- [ ] Verified-stale comments are corrected where they document a live invariant, deleted only where obsolete
- [ ] No load-bearing invariant is lost; measured-fact and anti-refactor warnings stay verbatim

## CORRECTION (plan-review BLOCK, criteria E4/G1G2/G6)

### 1. The dominant-category count was wrong — re-measured

The body claims "28 sites carrying 'RELOCATED VERBATIM ... forced by the LOCKED 800-line cap'
(~75 lines)". That is not borne out by the tree. Measured over
`src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/`:

    $ grep -rn "RELOCATED VERBATIM" src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler | wc -l
    6                       # 6 sites, ALL under adapters/jira_datacenter/
    $ grep -rniE "800-line|LOCKED 800|module-size cap" src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler | wc -l
    6                       # a SEPARATE, smaller set (transport.py, retry.py, transitions.py)
    $ grep -rliE "RELOCATED VERBATIM|800-line|LOCKED 800|module-size cap" ... | wc -l
    10                      # 10 distinct files carry EITHER marker

No single site carries the quoted combined marker. The two families are disjoint, and neither is
close to 28. The real figure is **~12 occurrences across 10 files**, not 28.

**Consequence for the shard's headline yield.** The "~970 lines leave" estimate was built on the
inflated count for its largest single category. That estimate is therefore UNRELIABLE and must not
be treated as a target. The implementer MEASURES the actual recoverable total and records it on
this ticket; the number is an output of the work, not an input to it. Do not manufacture
relocations to reach ~970.

### 2. Write-ordering must cover the ADRs, not just `do_not_move`

The plan requires the `do_not_move` list to be appended to `.joe-janitor/tools.md` BEFORE any edit
lands, but says nothing about ordering for the four proposed new ADRs (field-convergence
fit-then-normalize; pagination-stall aborts past fail-open handlers; unmapped relations skipped not
approximated; core owns the value maps) or the amendments to ADR 0028/0055/0031/0035.

Those ADRs are the single-source DESTINATIONS for the arguments currently restated 4-8 times. If a
comment citing "see ADR NNNN" is collapsed before ADR NNNN exists, the citation dangles and the
argument is simply LOST — which is the opposite of relocation and is not recoverable from the diff
by a later reader.

## Acceptance Criteria (supersedes the list above)

- [ ] The shard's `do_not_move` list is appended to `.joe-janitor/tools.md` BEFORE any edit lands
- [ ] Each new ADR and each amendment EXISTS AND IS COMMITTED before any comment that will cite it
      is collapsed or deleted — destination first, then the relocation
- [ ] Every non-KEEP unit in scope is relocated or deleted per its destination; nothing is deleted
      without a destination that already exists
- [ ] The ACTUAL recoverable line count is measured and recorded on this ticket, replacing the
      unreliable ~970 estimate. The measured marker counts (6 RELOCATED VERBATIM, 6 cap mentions,
      10 files) are the corrected baseline
- [ ] Verified-stale comments are CORRECTED where they document a live invariant, deleted only
      where obsolete — specifically `_backend_registry.py`'s "STUB: signatures pinned, bodies to be
      implemented" (false: `select_backend` is imported by 13 modules) and the S3/S4-not-landed
      notes in `_backend.py` and `adapters/jira/backend.py`
- [ ] No load-bearing invariant is lost; measured external-API facts and anti-refactor warnings
      stay VERBATIM (this subtree's comments are overwhelmingly measured facts that cannot be
      re-derived from code — the do_not_move list is the most valuable output of the shard)
- [ ] No behaviour change: the reconciler's tests pass unchanged
